subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should messages.tts keep automatic fallback across configured providers by default, or should a configured provider be sticky/fail-closed for auto-TTS when it fails or is skipped?
rationale: Current source, docs, and tests intentionally preserve fallback behavior, but this report shows that the behavior can surprise users and make ElevenLabs look ignored after configuration.

options.title: Keep fallback default, design explicit stickiness
options.body: Preserve the documented fallback chain and add or document an explicit strict/sticky provider path only if maintainers want users to opt into fail-closed provider selection.

options.title: Make configured provider sticky by default
options.body: Change messages.tts synthesis so the configured provider fails visibly instead of trying other configured providers, then update docs and tests for the compatibility change.

options.title: Close as expected fallback behavior
options.body: Treat fallback-to-OpenAI as intended when ElevenLabs fails or is skipped, and leave only diagnostics/education work for future reports.

recommendation.title: Keep fallback default, design explicit stickiness
recommendation.body: Preserve the documented fallback chain and add or document an explicit strict/sticky provider path only if maintainers want users to opt into fail-closed provider selection.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant authored the related diagnostics PRs and already framed provider stickiness as the remaining decision in the issue discussion.
